Native JSON download contains canonical evidence/owner recovery and excludes the collection credential.
Stopping the real receiver retains an edited comment pending; closing/reopening on the same origin after receiver restart delivers its latest revision with no duplicate logical rows.
Settings selects BM without losing metrics; desktop, phone and landscape use internal report scrolling with no document overflow.
Operator CLI exports both received logical rows from the real database without capability secrets.
Draw flies from the pile; the actual paid result is saved before motion; inert clones disappear and real cards return.

Desktop, phone and landscape have no page overflow; resizing immediately cleans up.
